headline: AI edits that put unlikely pairs into the "Hotel Lobby" rap performance by Quavo and Takeoff have gone viral, while some people object because Takeoff has died.
score_reason: Kept at the pool score: a live trend with an ethical side, but one explainer source and unverified view counts.
importance_line: The edits matter to fans and to families of late artists, since the article says rules on AI copies of dead performers are unclear, but the view count and the legal comments come from an explainer that names no lawyers.
summary: ED Times, listing the BBC, the Associated Press and Complex as its sources, reports that since September 2026 AI edits that swap other pairs, from cats to Barack and Michelle Obama, into rappers Quavo and Takeoff's 2022 "Hotel Lobby" performance have drawn what it says is over 100 million views across TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. Because Takeoff was shot dead in November 2022, some fans call the edits tasteless, and Quavo and singer Victoria Monét recreated the scene in person with the caption "No AI".
notes: Read from fulltext. The Takeoff death date is ED Times citing AP and BBC; not checked against those outlets here.
